panels.description:
**The case this variant exists to survive.** These edges contain a cycle (`api -> db` and `db -> api`). ECharts' sankey layout throws on cyclic input — and the throw is not `__DEV__`-guarded, so a production build would render a blank, broken panel.

The converter breaks the cycle before ECharts sees the links (`converters/dag.ts`) and reports the cost in the bottom-left note. Compare the node graph to the right to see which link was removed.

panels.description:
Identical queries to the sankey on the left of the row above, rendered by the `graph` variant instead. One converter, two layouts: switching Chart type re-renders the same `{ nodes, links }` model, and `graph` keeps the cycle because it accepts any digraph.

Layout is Circular for a stable picture; the panel default is Force.

panels.description:
**Show node values** on. Each node label gains a second line carrying that node's `mainstat`, formatted with the field's unit and decimals — the same value, and the same `stat ?? value` precedence, the tooltip shows.

The option is shared by all three render variants and rides on the node label, so it is hidden in the editor when **Show node labels** is off.
